resources.string:
DayBoard is a private daily planner. It has no internet access, no accounts, no ads and no analytics. Your data stays in private app storage until you export it yourself.

Due times are wall-clock times: a task due at 09:00 stays at 09:00 after a daylight saving change or when you travel to another time zone. A time skipped by a clock change fires right after the gap, and a repeated hour fires only once.

Exact reminders need the alarms permission. Without it, reminders are approximate and Android may delay them.
Quick add a task for today
No tasks yet. Add one above.
Mark %1$s as done or not done
All completed one-time tasks will be deleted. Repeating tasks stay. This cannot be undone.
No habits yet. Add one above.
No stream slots yet. Add a weekly slot, then copy the schedule for Discord.
This text has %1$d characters. Discord allows %2$d in one message, so paste it in two parts or remove slots.
Export writes all your data to a JSON file you choose. The file is not encrypted, so keep it somewhere private. Import checks the whole file first and asks before replacing anything.
Exact reminders: on. Reminders fire at the due time.
Exact reminders: off. Reminders are approximate and Android may delay them.
Notifications: refused. Reminders are saved, but no alert will appear.
This backup has %1$d tasks, %2$d habits and %3$d stream slots. All current data will be replaced. This cannot be undone, so export first if you are unsure.
